subject: Prevent crash on Valkey 7.2 when loading valkey-search (#427)
reason: The change only alters module load-time behaviour on Valkey servers older than 8.1.1 (e.g. 7.2): it moves the minimum-version check before the calls to ACL/command-registration APIs that don't exist there, and guards against ValkeyModule_GetServerVersion being null, so MODULE LOAD fails cleanly instead of crashing. The fuzzer loads both module builds into a single pinned modern Valkey build where the version check passes identically on the change and the parent, the module loads successfully on both, and no post-load behaviour is touched by the diff.
